scientific_question: Which of eight prospectively frozen multivariate combination architectures, evaluated under one common target, causal timing rule, gross mapping, cash economics and cost model, can robustly improve full-cycle net CAGR versus closed 0064?

feature_contract.missing_feature_imputation: TRAINING_COLUMN_MEDIAN_FROZEN_AT_EACH_REFIT; if a column is all-missing in eligible fit data the architecture fit fails for that refit/config rather than substituting another feature

time_contract.refit_label_eligibility: At refit date t, training may include only origins whose t+20 target endpoint is strictly earlier than t.
time_contract.decision_timing: Features and model forecast computed after completed UTC close t. The resulting outer multiplier g[t] is applied only to the next portfolio return row t+1; same-row return use is forbidden.

A01_FAMILY_ELASTIC_NET.estimator: StandardScaler fit on eligible training data then sklearn ElasticNet

A02_RAW_ELASTIC_NET.estimator: training-median imputation then StandardScaler then sklearn ElasticNet

A03_PCR_RIDGE.estimator: training-median imputation then StandardScaler then PCA fit on training only then Ridge

A04_THEORY_QUADRATIC_HESSIAN_RIDGE.inputs: 17 family scores + 17 squared terms + 10 fixed cross-family products
A04_THEORY_QUADRATIC_HESSIAN_RIDGE.estimator: training-median imputation then StandardScaler on expanded matrix then Ridge

A05_GAM_SPLINE_RIDGE.estimator: training-median imputation then sklearn SplineTransformer per full matrix with degree=3 include_bias=false then StandardScaler then Ridge

A07_HMM_REGIME_MIXTURE_RIDGE.inputs: 4 theory meta-factors for Gaussian HMM plus 17 family scores for state-specific Ridge
A07_HMM_REGIME_MIXTURE_RIDGE.meta_factor_formula: equal-weight arithmetic mean of available frozen family scores in each block after training-median imputation
A07_HMM_REGIME_MIXTURE_RIDGE.state_regression: For each state, fit Ridge to 17 standardized family scores with sample_weight equal to HMM posterior state probability; prediction is posterior-probability-weighted mixture of state-specific Ridge predictions.
A07_HMM_REGIME_MIXTURE_RIDGE.method_fit_failure_rule: A failed config is persisted as MODEL_FIT_FAILURE and is never retried with altered semantics. If all six validation configs fail, A07 final status is MODEL_FIT_FAILURE and no evaluation CAGR is fabricated.

A08_STACKED_ENSEMBLE.inputs: causal validation predictions from validation-selected A01-A07
A08_STACKED_ENSEMBLE.estimator: scipy.optimize.nnls on validation prediction matrix vs Y20 target; normalize nonnegative weights to sum one
A08_STACKED_ENSEMBLE.fallback: if NNLS weights are all zero or non-finite, use equal 1/7 weights

gross_mapping.calibration_sample: eligible fit sample at each refit
gross_mapping.prediction_location: median of model fitted predictions on eligible fit sample
gross_mapping.prediction_scale: 1.4826 * median absolute deviation of model fitted predictions on eligible fit sample

portfolio_economics.base_return: already-costed BRRK-0011 daily return reconstructed from frozen daily_equity.csv
portfolio_economics.decision_and_return_alignment: forecast after close t creates g[t]; portfolio return row t+1 uses g[t]
portfolio_economics.benchmark_reconstruction_rule: forcing every g=1 must reproduce frozen 0064 primary path within 1e-12 per-row arithmetic tolerance and terminal/CAGR/MDD anchor tolerance

evaluation_gates.G0_CONTRACT_AND_DATA_IDENTITY: all frozen Git blobs, payload hashes, architecture count, config count and formulas exact
evaluation_gates.G1_SUPPORT_AND_BASELINE_RECONSTRUCTION: evaluation dates exactly 2022-12-10..2026-08-02, baseline 0064 anchors reconstruct, and all required prediction rows are causally available
evaluation_gates.G2_NET_WEALTH_AND_CAGR: method terminal wealth > 0064 terminal wealth AND method calendar CAGR > 0064 calendar CAGR
evaluation_gates.G4_TEMPORAL_RECURRENCE: at least 3 of 4 count-balanced contiguous evaluation blocks have positive relative log growth versus 0064
evaluation_gates.G5_SIMULTANEOUS_DEPENDENCE_AWARE_LCB: method simultaneous one-sided 95% LCB of mean relative log increment versus 0064 strictly > 0 after correction across all valid final architectures
evaluation_gates.G6_COST_AND_TURNOVER_REALISM: all outer turnover costs are included by frozen formula; no negative cash, leverage, shorting or architecture-specific cost waiver

simultaneous_inference.series: daily relative log increment for each valid final architecture versus 0064
simultaneous_inference.correction: For each replicate compute all valid method mean relative-log increments on the same sampled indices. q95 is Type-7 95th percentile of max_i(observed_mean_i - bootstrap_mean_i). LCB_i=observed_mean_i-q95.

temporal_blocks.construction: count-balanced contiguous evaluation rows, earlier blocks receive remainder

PBO_CSCV.selection_statistic: annualized Sharpe computed from candidate daily returns within in-sample slices; risk-free subtraction omitted because identical selection comparison uses net candidate returns
PBO_CSCV.oos_rank: rank selected in-sample winner by OOS Sharpe among valid final architectures with average ties
PBO_CSCV.PBO: fraction of 70 splits where selected in-sample winner has OOS rank at or below the median valid architecture rank

DEFLATED_SHARPE.implementation: deterministic Bailey-Lopez-de-Prado-style deflated Sharpe diagnostic using observed skew/kurtosis, sample length and 71 declared trials; if numerical assumptions fail report NOT_WELL_DEFINED rather than substituting another metric

classification.pass: PASS_MULTI_ARCHITECTURE_GROSS_CONTROLLER if at least one final architecture passes G0-G6 and G5 simultaneous LCB
classification.fail: FAIL_NO_ROBUST_MULTI_ARCHITECTURE_IMPROVEMENT if G0/G1 pass, all available final methods are evaluated under frozen semantics, and none passes all G2-G6
classification.invalid: INVALID_EXECUTION for core identity, causal timing, variant-budget, common-map, cost, exactly-once or persistence violation
classification.measurement_inconclusive: MEASUREMENT_INCONCLUSIVE if frozen data/support cannot satisfy G1 without substitution

exactly_once.marker_only_recovery: allowed only from complete persisted result/evidence/execution hashes without historical reread
